plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg has an idea that there was once a nuclear war on Mars. A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says he spent several days with Brandenburg in New Mexico and wrote about his research in his book Closer Encounters. According to Jorjani, Brandenburg found that the mix of xenon-129, a form of the gas xenon that nuclear reactions produce, is unusual at Cydonia, a region of Mars. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it too. He adds argon-40, another gas, and says both exist on Mars in greater amounts than natural decay would explain. Once he credits an unnamed friend who worked at the national weapons labs Lawrence Livermore and Sandia, and once he names Brandenburg. If true, it would mean Mars once held a civilisation that destroyed itself with nuclear weapons.
